cat > /root/projects/verifier-tts-struct-ie/scripts/run_all.sh << 'ENDSCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/projects/verifier-tts-struct-ie
PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3

echo "=== Starting N=1 greedy ==="
for i in $(seq 0 7); do
    PORT=$((8000 + i))
    $PYTHON scripts/inference.py \
        --shard_file data/test_shard_${i}.jsonl \
        --port $PORT \
        --n_candidates 1 \
        --seed 42 \
        --output_dir results > results/log_shard${i}_n1.txt 2>&1 &
done
wait
echo "=== N=1 done ==="

for N in 4 8 16; do
    for SEED in 42 123 456; do
        echo "=== Starting N=$N seed=$SEED ==="
        for i in $(seq 0 7); do
            PORT=$((8000 + i))
            $PYTHON scripts/inference.py \
                --shard_file data/test_shard_${i}.jsonl \
                --port $PORT \
                --n_candidates $N \
                --seed $SEED \
                --output_dir results > results/log_shard${i}_n${N}_seed${SEED}.txt 2>&1 &
        done
        wait
        echo "=== N=$N seed=$SEED done ==="
    done
done

echo "=== ALL INFERENCE DONE ==="

# Aggregate
$PYTHON scripts/aggregate.py \
    --results_dir results \
    --gold_file data/test_gold.jsonl \
    --output_file results/final_results.json

echo "=== AGGREGATION DONE ==="
ENDSCRIPT
chmod +x /root/projects/verifier-tts-struct-ie/scripts/run_all.sh
echo "run_all.sh created"

Oracle-greedy gap 为 6.49 F1 点 (N=16)，表明模型在不同候选中确实产生了互补的正确实体。Self-consistency 失败的原因可能是 exact string matching——实体文本的微小差异（如 "word embeddings" vs "word embedding"）导致投票分裂。这正是 StructTTS 提出 IoU-based soft matching 的动机：下一步应实现 span-level IoU matching 替代 exact match，预期可显著缩小 oracle-aggregation gap。
